opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers toward OneCoin participation through a signup link and a process tied to token withdrawal, mining, and coin conversion. Its description provides a OneCoin signup URL, while the sampled frame visibly presents token payment, mining application, and coin conversion as connected steps. The narration further says, "When you withdraw your tokens, The coins are generated in your personal account." It promotes appreciation by stating, "The price of the cryptocurrency will continue to rise in the growing network based on demand and supply," and promises, "With OneCoin, we will be rich in finance." Although the presentation includes credibility-building imagery and says, "The scenario is not guaranteed by any means," those qualifications do not remove the central solicitation and wealth-oriented appreciation claims. The available evidence does not establish actual payment, realized returns, or victim losses.
